scope: Early formal v4 synthetic authoring, before any student Calibration or Test scoring
failure_class: A nonempty selected value was duplicated as the entire unselected prefix with an empty suffix; literal paste retained the old value
repair: Original inputs, labels and teacher audits retained privately; regenerate those slots under an explicit authoring boundary constraint
domain_constraint: Exact duplicated selection-boundary patterns are excluded from this synthetic corpus, including the mirrored suffix pattern; actual production AX behavior is unchanged
limitation: Agreement between multiple teacher calls does not establish semantic correctness; these counts describe authoring quality, not model accuracy
